scope: Extend the existing one-per-run inference retry to normalized OpenAI HTTP 5xx errors and exact Connection error. No action replay or new retry allowance.

tests.before: 3/3 new scripted-provider regression cases fail on original runtime.
tests.targeted_after: 8/8 pass, including preserved-data and retry-boundary suites.

contracts: Prior JavaScript records survive retry; failed partial response tools do not execute.
HTTP 520, HTTP 503 and exact Connection error. recover on a succeeding inference response.
Repeated HTTP/connection failures stop after one SDK retry.
Original step/cost/cancellation guards remain in force.
Tested HTTP 400/401/403 and appended access-denial messages gain no retry.
compatibility: No model, task prompt, dependency, public API option, profile or history format change. Additional attempt can add latency/cost; rollback is previous SDK SHA.
limitations: Local scripted-provider tests establish recovery behavior, not live provider availability or benchmark quality.
Running confirmation4 runtime ce3d029 does not contain this patch; original zeros and missing judgments remain.
